name: Tailscale
description: Tailscale is a zero-trust, identity-based connectivity platform built on WireGuard that replaces legacy VPNs with a secure mesh network between devices.
best_for: IT teams managing remote workforces, DevOps engineers managing multi-cloud infrastructure, and developers wanting simplified, secure networking.
features: Mesh overlay network connecting devices without centralized servers
WireGuard-based encryption for modern cryptographic security
Zero-config networking with setup in minutes
Identity-based access control tying permissions to user identity
Automatic NAT traversal across firewalls and multiple NATs
Support for Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, and NAS devices

alternatives.name: Cloudflare
alternatives.description: A network and security platform offering CDN, DDoS protection, and zero-trust access tools.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting network performance and security in one platform

alternatives.name: Okta
alternatives.description: An identity and access management platform for single sign-on and user authentication.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises managing identity across many applications

cons: The Personal plan is capped at 6 users, so teams beyond that size need a paid plan.
Standard and Premium include limits on ACL groups and ephemeral-resource minutes; higher usage or advanced controls can require Premium, Enterprise, or add-ons.
